links.outcome: Rate of harmful decision flips from correct to incorrect after LLM-generated information
links.effect: LLMs induce an average 2.81% rate of harmful decision flips across different models, where clinician participants change from a correct to an incorrect answer.
links.quote: By measuring how LLM-generated information affects decisions, we observe that LLMs induce an average 2.81% rate of harmful decision flips across different models, where clinician participants change from a correct to an incorrect answer.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating rhetorical presentation of LLM outputs for induced cognitive biases (anchoring, authority bias, loss aversion)
Using LLM-simulated decision-makers to computationally measure rhetorical misalignment

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating how rhetorical presentation in LLM outputs induces cognitive biases and harmful decision flips among clinician participants in simulated USMLE decision-making tasks.
